restaurantName: Ma Lu Qiao Jiang Tang Mian
address: 306 East Zhongshan Road, Jiaojiang, Taizhou, Chinese Mainland
bio: This shop specialising in ginger broth has been going strong for more than half a century. Every morning at 5 am, the owner makes the broth with ginger that is marinated in yellow wine and sun-dried for a rounded flavour. For starch, order hand-rolled noodles, rice noodles, rice cakes or even steamed rice to go in the broth. Feel free to top up with an assortment of seafood like shrimp, razor clam, mantis shrimp, mud crab or Bombay duck.
pageTitle: Ma Lu Qiao Jiang Tang Mian
